title: Tax Desk Bulletin — Occupancy Tax Collected With Installment 1
content:
# Tax desk bulletin — occupancy tax collected with installment 1

**Rule.** The occupancy tax of installment 1 of a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category depends on the stay and its jurisdiction:

1. a stay whose nights reach the jurisdiction's exempt minimum carries none;
2. a stay in a jurisdiction that levies a flat amount per night carries the percentage rate of what installment 1 carries plus the flat amount for each night installment 1 carries, a pay-part-now installment 1 carrying the deposit percentage of the stay's policy of each night's flat amount;
3. any other stay carries the percentage rate of what installment 1 carries.

The tax is rounded half up to the cent. The nights installment 1 carries are the nights per monthly installment of the stay's policy on a stay paid in monthly installments (every night of the stay where it has fewer), the deposit percentage of the stay's nights on a pay-part-now stay, and every night of the stay otherwise. The jurisdiction is the one recorded on the stay.

## Jurisdiction figures

| Jurisdiction | Exempt minimum nights | Percentage rate | Flat amount per night |
|---|---|---|---|
| TX-AUSTIN | 30 | 17.00% | none |
| FL-ORANGE | 183 | 12.50% | none |
| CO-DENVER | 30 | 15.75% | none |
| TN-NASHVILLE | 30 | 15.25% | 2.50 |
| HI-HONOLULU | 180 | 17.96% | none |
| CA-SAN-DIEGO | 30 | 12.50% | none |

Policy figures used for the nights carried: nights per monthly installment 30 on Long-Term and 0 on every other policy; pay-part-now deposit 50.00% on Flexible, Moderate, Limited and Firm and 0.00% on Strict, Super Strict 30 Days, Super Strict 60 Days and Long-Term.

## Cases (hypothetical stays)

| Stay | Branch | Tax on installment 1 |
|---|---|---|
| 30 nights, TX-AUSTIN | reaches the minimum of 30 | none |
| 29 nights, TX-AUSTIN, carrying 3,000.00 | percentage only | 510.00 |
| 6 nights, TN-NASHVILLE, pay-part-now, carrying 575.00 | flat amount levied | 15.25% of 575.00 is 87.6875, plus 2.50 for each of 3 nights (50% of 6), 7.50: 95.19 |
| 40 nights, FL-ORANGE, monthly, carrying 3,850.00 | under 183; percentage only | 481.25 |
